g.text: The remaining error is concentrated in specific conditions
Selected coefficient penalty, 32 parents × 8 directions · each panel partitions the same diagnostic mean squared error
Each parent has 24 equally weighted queries, so these contributions preserve equal parent weight.
The panels are alternative partitions, not additive causes; concentration does not by itself identify the missing mechanism.
